senses.gloss: coin, medal. טִבְעוֹ של פ׳ יצא one’s coin passes, i.e. one’s authority is recognized.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 6b:13">Shebu. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>זו רומי חייבת שטִיבְעָהּ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>פרס</he>) that is wicked Rome whose government is recognized all over the world.

<cite ref="Megillah 14b:1">Meg. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יצא טִבְעֲךָ בעולם</he> thou art not yet the legitimate king; cmp. <cite ref="M00537"><he>מוֹנִיטָא</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:8">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ</cite> <he>מטבעה של תפלה</he> ed. Lehm., oth. ed. <he>מטביעה</he>, v. <cite ref="M00965"><he>מַטְבֵּעַ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: Tebʿa, a coin equal to half a Sela.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:3:5">Y. Shek. II, 46ᵈ</cite> top (the ten brothers) sold Rachel’s first-born for twenty silver pieces (denars) <he>ונפל לכל א׳ וא׳ מהם ט׳</he> so that a Tebʿa came upon each (Bab. ed. <he>טבעה</he>, <he>טיבעה</he>, Ms. M. <he>טובע</he>).—Pl. <he>טְבָעִים</he>, <he>טְבָעִין</he> (<cite ref="I00120"><he>טוֹבְעִין</he></cite>, fr. <he>טוֹבַע</he>).
Shek. II, 4. Y. l. c. טו׳ פלגי סלעין (Bab. טבעין) tibʿin i.e. half-Shekels.

senses.gloss: that which is to be shaped, substance, element.—Pl. as ab.
units: Num. R. s. 14 כנגד ארבעה ט׳ וכ׳ corresponding to the four elements of which the Lord created &c. [In later Hebr.: nature, character; Nature.]
